description: We’re a team of curious minds, science lovers, storytellers, and challenge takers. We’re excited to explore space-related topics and ready to roll up our sleeves and dive in. We learn by doing and love working together. Our interests include astrophysics, space, gaming, coding, design, storytelling, and problem-solving—and we’re always eager to explore something new!
summary:
We were given a challenge, to create a game that helps kids follow their dreams of becoming astronauts and learn astronomy. The official website says our challenge is to design an interactive game or app that lets students run a lunar or Martian outpost. It also says we need to include factors such as life support, radiation, food, and supplies. We needed to come up with an idea first. We decided to create a 2D game that requires the player to choose what to do and perform tasks daily.

Our game, Outpost 7, uses real life problems that astronauts face in space, such as radiation, food shortage, and lack of oxygen. This allows kids to actually simulate life on other astronomical bodies whilst playing a fun game. The players must eat, drink, save enough energy, and survive, all while collecting science points to build new buildings, solar panels, and more. If just one thing goes wrong, like an oxygen leak, the astronauts lose resources and could possibly die. Education and games come together in Outpost 7.

The game is made to teach kids about space, decisions, and to have fun. It also educates kids who have no access to real space education. The game has real space info, such as from DONKI, NASA, and NOAA. Some decisions are life or death, while others are just to maintain or improve the spaceship or health.
details: The game provides space astronaut education to kids in a fun game environment. It provides close to real life simulation based on live NASA data and easy access to kids who have passion and curiosity for space mission. The game is open ended building with real science goal. It's coded using html, Python and JavaScript with AI assisted coding tool. Our team considers the balance between science knowledge and player experience for the specific age group.
